text: Mideyah is a Khajiit residing in the city of Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Miglah is a Khajiit residing in the city of Woodhearth, Greenshade.
Meshouz is a Redguard beggar residing in the Warehouse District in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.

Mils Lerano is a Dunmer residing in Balmora, Vvardenfell, in . He is the son of Gilan Lerano and Bravora Faren. His sister is Neria Lerano. Mils fishes in Balmora's canal to keep him and his sister fed.
Milvena Uvayn is a Dunmer commoner residing in the Saint Delyn Waistworks of Vivec City. She has a Vvardvark companion, Ambanmil.
Methel Darithran is a Dunmer pilgrim residing in the Saint Olms Waistworks in the upper level of the Canton of St. Olms the Just in Vivec City. He has no unique dialogue.
Mikarash is a Khajiit crafter residing in the Saint Olms Waistworks on the upper level of the Canton of St. Olms the Just in Vivec City. He has no unique dialogue.
Methei is an Argonian residing at the Foyada Quarry. She has no unique dialogue and cannot be interacted with.
Midiri Berathi is a Dunmer residing in Tel Aruhn, in Vvardenfell, under the employ of Magister Gothren. She will be guarding the tower entrance during the quest "Objections and Obstacles."
Mercuro Verres is an Imperial laborer residing in Balmora, Vvardenfell.
Midnight Union Butcher is a generic Butcher residing in locations .
Midnight Union Deadeye is a generic Deadeye residing in several locations in .
Midar is a Dunmer member of House Telvanni and an apprentice of Divayth Fyr found in Tel Fyr on Vvardenfell.
Midnight Butcher is a generic character residing in Cave of Dreams. They are members of the Midnight Union, a faction in Stormhaven.
Midnight Deadeye is a generic character residing in Stormhaven. They are members of the Midnight Union, a faction in Stormhaven.
Midnight Striker is a generic character residing in Stormhaven. They are members of the Midnight Union, a faction in Stormhaven.
Mighty Chudan is a monster set in . It can be obtained from Urgarlag Chief-bane or dropped in Veteran Ruins of Mazzatun.

Methulu Drinith is a Dunmer soldier and member of the Clockwork Apostles residing in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City. She can be found standing guard inside the Clockwork Basilica. She has no unique dialogue
Midnight Union Striker is a member of the Midnight Union in Vaermina's Shrine.
Mihufeh is a Redguard found at the northern part of the Shimmerene Dockworks in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. He has no unique dialogue.
Milmendien is an Altmer commoner found at the northern part of the Shimmerene Dockworks in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. He has no unique dialogue.
Merfnovira is a Nord member of the Fighters Guild training outside the guildhall in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset.

Mihra af-Abadiran is a Redguard found with her companion Kylian Astier at their campsite at one of their possible locations in Deshaan. The Vestige can light their fire as part of the Lightbringer achievement.
Merenfire is an Altmer who can be found in the Illumination Academy in Summerset.
Milerond is an Altmer who can be found in Lillandril docks in Summerset.
Milzus is an Argonian member of the Bright-Throat Tribe who can be found in the Bright-Throat Village. She is traumatized after finding the dying Danlai.
Migarra is a Khajiit fence found in the Rimmen Outlaws Refuge in Rimmen, Northern Elsweyr. She runs the Slick-Whisker Mercantile stall.
Mero Dobellis is an Imperial residing in his house in Senchal, Southern Elsweyr. He has no unique dialogue.
Millengor is a Winterborn boss who appears with Janavynn and Wuhkusto in the western interior of Old Orsinium in .
Milkshop is a senche-lion in . He resides in Numaia's ranch in the Prowl. He had almost starved to death in a pit before Numaia rescued him.
Mewah-Jez is a Naga ka-deelith residing in Dead-Water Village.
Mhurchan is a Redguard child servant in who resides in the greenhouse of Castle Sentinel.
Milta is a Redguard who resides at the Damar Farmstead in Bangkorai. She is Shalan's daughter and a fiancee of Damar.
Merilar Severin is a Dunmer residing in the Slag Town Outlaws Refuge.
Messenger Cordier is a Breton residing in Koeglin Village, Stormhaven, in . He has been taken by slavers to the warehouse in the docks. He later returns to Alcaire Castle after being rescued.

Mirel is a Golden Saint lieutenant serving under Aurmazl Kaneh during the conflict between the Golden Saints and the Dark Seducers for Sheogorath's favor at Cylarne. He led the Aureal scouts at Cylarne, and was responsible for discovering the weakness in the Dark Seducer defenses within Cylarne's Underdeep, shortly before the arrival of the Hero to re-light the Flame of Agnon.
Minassour is a Dunmer Champion, and Ashlander living in Zainab Camp, in Morrowind.
Miner Gor is a Redguard miner from the Shulk Egg Mine in Morrowind.
Miner Kati is a Redguard miner from the Shulk Egg Mine in Morrowind. They are seen during the quest "Egg Poachers."

Minedhel is a Bosmer thief that can be found in Sorkvild's Tower near Dagon Fel. He is equipped with one of the three Saint's Black Swords in , and wears a combination of Chitin and Netch Leather armor.
Miron Garer is a Dunmer commoner residing in Khuul. He can typically be found in his shack in the southern area of the village.
Mirabelle Monet is the Breton proprietress of The Fo'c's'le located at the Anvil docks. She is also a Journeyman Sneak Trainer.

Mirisa is a traveling Redguard hunter living at Crestbridge Camp near Cropsford. When she's not hunting or playing host to the refugee farmers from Cropsford, she's off delivering fresh meat to the Imperial Bridge Inn on the banks of the Silverfish River.

Mirili Ulven is a Dunmer sorcerer researcher living in Highcross. She is usually found in her house or walking around town. Mirili puts all of her time and energy into learning about the creatures and plants of the Shivering Isles, and has little interest of anything else going on unless it starts to effect her.

Mirabelle Ervine is a Breton mage and the Master Wizard of the College of Winterhold, a position she will fill until her death at the hands of Ancano during the quest "The Staff of Magnus." She is the author of the note Per Your Requests.
Minette Vinius is a Nord child who lives in Solitude with her family.
Mistress Dratha is a Dunmer sorceress in who resides in the upper tower of Tel Mora. She is a master and Councilor of House Telvanni, with Raven Omayn serving as her Mouth.
Mirvon Andrethi is a Dunmer Monk and member of House Telvanni. He resides in Tel Vos in Vvardenfell, Morrowind, and offers skill training.

Mithorpa Nasyal is a Dunmer in who was originally intended to reside at Barleydark Farm. The farm was cut from the game entirely; Mithorpa is still in the game's files, although in this sense he is not present under normal conditions.
Minerva is a Redguard who resides in the Inn of Ill Omen. Her room is located in the upstairs area, second door on the left. She is not involved in any services or training.
Miner Arobar is a Dunmer crusader and Councilor for House Redoran. He resides in Arobar Manor in Ald'ruhn.

Mith was a Nord/Chimer member of Moraelyn's Companions sometime during the First Era. He appears in the King Edward book series. Mith grew up in Blacklight as a stable boy before leaving with Moraelyn.
Minasi Bavani is a Dunmer thief that resides in Nevrila Areloth's House in Sadrith Mora. She is a member of the Camonna Tong.
Miraso Seran is a Dunmer enchanter and merchant who resides at the Telvanni Council House in Sadrith Mora. She is an Initiate-ranked member of the Tribunal Temple.
Minorne is an Altmer mage in who has infiltrated the ruins of Ruunvald, an important base for the Vigilants of Stendarr. Minorne is encountered as part of the Dawnguard questline.
Mindeli Saren is a Dunmer warrior who can be found at the Yasammidan shrine.
Mirri Severin is a Dunmer who lives on Solstheim. She is the daughter of Vendil Severin and Tilisu Severin and part of a wealthy family that has contributed to Raven Rock.
Mireli is a deceased miner who can be found in Kolbjorn Barrow during the second stage of the quest "Unearthed." She has a note entitled Mireli's Letter to Mother.
Missun Akin is a Dunmer in who can be found in his hut at the Dunmer stronghold of Falasmaryon.
Mitanne Limaxis a Breton commoner who can be found in The Winged Guar in Mournhold's quarter Godsreach.

Mirtil Angoth was a Snow Elf who lived during the Merethic Era. A survivor of the Nordic-Falmer War, it is unknown if she suffered the same fate as her other Snow Elf brethren. During the war, she wrote a journal about her survival, and what the Snow Elves were trying to do to escape the genocide and brutality that the Nords were committing.
Missun Hainterari is a hostile Dunmer Archer and Ashlander outcast found just outside Maesat's Yurt in the Mamshar-Disamus Camp.
Missamsi Timmiriran is an Dunmer Mabrigash who resides in the Azura's Coast region located within Morrowind.
Minisun Ulirbabi is a Dunmer Barbarian found in a Shashmanu Camp just east of Ald Velothi with his companion Zalabelk Saladnius. When the Nerevarine approaches them, they will attack.

Minnibi Selkin-Adda is an Dunmer Nightblade and a member of the Morag Tong. He can be located underneath Vivec, Arena Canton within the Vivec, Arena Hidden Area. He will sell spells to faction members of Thrall or higher.
Mirionil is an Altmer soldier residing in Eagle's Strand in the region of Khenarthi's Roost. Apart from a dialogue line about the quality of Altmer ships, he has no other possible interactions.
Mistress Aramil is an Altmer mystic who resides in the Auridon city of Vulkhel Guard. She can be found in the Starfall Arcana shop.
Mingor is a Bosmer hunter residing in Stonetooth Fortress, Betnikh. He can be found around the docks trying to fish.
Miquel Eugenie is a Breton who resides in Daggerfall, Glenumbra. He can be found at The Rosy Lion inn.
Misapan is a Khajiit residing in Redfur Trading Post in the region of Grahtwood. Misapan is a Merchant-class character; however, items cannot be bought or sold from him.
Mistress Lamae is a cat owned by Lady Clarisse Laurent. She is found on her bed in her camp, which is next to the Tomb of Lost Kings in Glenumbra.
Miramel Lemaitre is a Breton residing in Wayrest, Stormhaven. She is the grocer in the Cloudy Dregs Inn, not far from the north gate in the city.
Minabibi Assardarainat is a Dunmer Wise Woman of the Ahemmusa Tribe who resides inside Favel Ancestral Tomb in the Grazelands region of Morrowind.
Mirani is a Khajiit working at the Laughing Moons Plantation.
Mirise Dres is a Dunmer of House Dres residing inside her house in Mournhold. She is the author of An Affair With Death.
Mindil the Untested is an Altmer Undaunted member residing in the city of Vulkhel Guard.
Mirnarie is an Altmer residing in the city of Marbruk. She can often be seen wandering around the cemetery, tending to one of the graves and writing letters. She is in deep mourning.
Mirarbinat is a Khajiit member of the Fighters Guild. He is found at their branch in Evermore.
Miroleine Vienne is a Breton member of the Mages Guild residing at the guildhall in the city of Evermore.
Mirusu Romoran is a Dunmer found inside the instruction halls of Shad Astula.
Mithen Callushands is a Bosmer in who resides in the city of Skywatch.
Minerva Lauzon is a Breton and a former member of the Blackcaster Mages Guild. Following the attack of her former colleagues on Elinhir, she led the residents to safety in the sewerworks.
Mingalion is a Bosmer found in the outlaws refuge beneath Rawl'kha.
Mirok the Deplorable is a Dremora found in the Village of the Lost.
Minbid-Dal is a Dunmer Ashlander of the Mabrigash Tribe. She is found at their village located in the Vale of the Ghost Snake.
Minriel is a Bosmer bard in who makes a performance at Skywatch Manor in the city of Skywatch next to her bodyguard, Enik-ja. She has no unique dialogue.
Mirten is a Breton fighters competing in The Swordmaster Division at the Thizzrini Arena.
Minonel is a Bosmer residing in the Shrouded Vale, in the region of Greenshade.
Minducil is an Altmer innkeeper working at Phynaster's Stride in the city of Haven.
Miranibi is a Khajiit hunter and member of the Baandari Clan in . She is found at their camp at Martyr's Crossing in Bankorai, High Rock.
The Mirnor of Auri-El is an Altmer priest outside Skywatch. He can be found preaching to several Skywatch Celebrants.
Mirabelle Motierre is a Breton assassin residing in the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary. Mirabelle has many disguises as a cover for her role as a Dark Brotherhood assassin.
Minantille is an Altmer noble and part of Queen Ayrenn's entourage.
Miremonwe Spellslinger is an Altmer member of the Bitterhand Bandits. He acts as the boss of the Flyleaf Catacombs.
Mirilir is a Bosmer found near the ruined settlement of Greenheart. He is married to Hartmin.
Miruin Woodwalker is a Bosmer working for House Montclair. He is part of the trio of bosses of Erokii.
Mimou Plourde is a Breton noble found at the party at the At-Tura Estate.
Minette Ronise is a Breton stablemaster. She sells her horses at the Mane and Muzzle in Kvatch.
Miquel Benele is a Breton residing inside his home in Wayrest.
Miranda Arcole is a Breton and the owner of Farangel's Landing, a small estate near Wayrest. She is currently being held hostage by the Midnight Union.
Minstrel Idria is a Dunmer bard performing at The Shining Star in the Hollow City. She has been unable to work ever since she lost her lute in The Grotto of Depravity.
Minal is a Khajiit member of the Aldmeri Dominion. He is found at the Eastern Elsweyr Gate.
Mirudda is a Khajiit leading the bandit gang found inside Sandblown Mine. She is found alongside her giant snake, Huzal.
Mistress Rilasi Dren is a Dunmer residing in Suran. She was the owner of Mistress Dren's Residence, a plantation nearby Suran.
Minotaur of the Grove is a unique leveled minotaur in that is encountered during the quest called Hircine.
Mistveil Enchanter is a creature card in that is a part of the Heroes of Skyrim expansion.
Mind Spider is a spider that appears in . This creature is required for the relevant quest, but cannot be attacked.
Minstrel Irdia is a Dunmer bard residing in The Shining Star; a locale in the Hollow City. She will ask for her Lute, F'lah, which is relatable to the quest The Lost Lute.
Mirili Tenim is a Dunmer member of the Clockwork Apostles found in the Clockwork Basilica in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City.
Mirili Terendas is a Dunmer member of the Clockwork Apostles found in the Clockwork Basilica in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City.
Minone Aloette is a Breton newcomer to Summerset held in a cage within the Undercroft Passage of the Monastery of Serene Harmony in Shimmerene.
Mishzin is a Khajiit found within the Undercroft Great Hall of the Monastery of Serene Harmony in Shimmerene. He has no unique dialogue.
Mindoril is a Bosmer found in Corgrad Wastes, Summerset. She is part of a group of outcasts led by Ruliel living near the ruins.
Mirulon is an Altmer leader of the Black Wake disguised as an exile, although he is actually a member of the Court of Bedlam using Arathel to assassinate the Sapiarch.
Minolewen is an Altmer who can be found in a camp near Sea Keep in Summerset. She cannot be interacted with.
Minwolhil is an Altmer who can be found in a vanguard camp near Sea Keep in Summerset. She cannot be interacted with.
Mingaenir is an Altmer who can be found in Lillandril docks near the wayshrine in Summerset. He cannot be interacted with.
Mimme is an Argonian egg-tender of the Bright-Throat Tribe who can be found in the Bright-Throat Village. She is the author of the book Hatchling's Rhyme.
Miriya is a Redguard female who was a former Dark Brotherhood member. She is trapped in K'Tora's mind trap along with Cainar.

Minasi Nelvilo is a Dunmer pirate in . She can be found tied by Timeo Dubroc at one of their possible locations accross the High Isle. After the Vestige starts talking with the knight, she unbinds herself and runs away.

Mindileth is a Bosmer located at Vineshade Lodge, Grahtwood, in . She only appears during the quest "Anti-Venom Agitation," and at her camp, she makes anti-venoms from native ingredients and wears a green and brown ceremonial dress.
Miun-Gei is an Argonian enchanter and merchant who resides at his shop in the Foreign Quarter of Vivec. Although not a member of any factions, he has connections to the Dark Brotherhood.
Mollimo of Cloudrest is an Altmer warrior and member of House Telvanni residing in Tel Branora, Morrowind.
Molvirian Palenix is an Imperial Guard living in Gnisis in the West Gash. He is also a recruit of the Imperial Legion.

Modryn Oreyn is the Champion of the Fighters Guild in Cyrodiil. He can be found in his home in the city of Chorrol. He is a rather sharp speaker, quick to irritate and anger, but fiercely loyal to the Fighters Guild, and proud of the members that show skill and competence. He has little tolerance for members who would tarnish its reputation, or those he deems as a threat to the guild, whether it is a single member or an entire chapter, as one worth looking over carefully.

Mojo is a dog that can be found in the Anvil Fighters Guild Dining Hall. He is counted as a Fighters Guild member. Attacking him while being a member of the Fighters Guild will result in being expelled.
Mivryna Arano is a Dunmer commoner who works at the Cheydinhal stables. When spoken to she refers to Tovas if one wants to buy a horse.
Mogens Wind-Shifter is a Nord bandit wizard and the leader of a group of bandits.

Mjoll the Lioness is a Nord warrior. She has traveled Tamriel extensively and claims to be as experienced and well traveled as one can be. She and Aerin may be found in the Bee and Barb inn, wandering around Riften, or in Aerin's House at night.
Molgrom Twice-Killed is a Nord thief and a member of the Thieves Guild in Riften.

Modellus, sometimes referred to as Lord Modellus, was a member of the Elder Council in 3E 120. Modellus' first appearance was in 3E 120. He is mentioned in the The Wolf Queen, Book V. It is said that Modellus was already a member of the Elder Council. Modellus' and the then-Princess Kintyra's relationship is also revealed. By the time Modellus and Kintrya II was already engaged. Second Modellus' appearance dates only year after, 3E 121. He is mentioned in the The Wolf Queen, Book VI. During Empress Kintrya's rule during the War of the Red Diamond Modellus led one of Imperial Armies. He was stationed in the Imperial City, but got tricked by Potema. She sent Modellus a false letter from Kintry
Mog gra-Mogakh is an Orsimer residing in the town of Skingrad. She runs the Two Sisters Lodge there with her sister, Ugak.

Mondros Balur is a Dunmer master-at-arms and a member of House Redoran. He can be found in the Morvayn Quarters in the Redoran Council Hall, within the city of Ald'ruhn. As a Master-at-Arms, Mondros offers medium training in long blade, axe and blunt weapon.

Mivanu Retheran is a Dunmer savant and member of House Redoran who resides inside the Redoran Council Hall in the city of Ald'ruhn. She is also a minor skill trainer in Mercantile, Speechcraft, and Athletics.
Moghakh gro-Bar is an Orsimer Barbarian residing in Kaushtarari.
Mogak gra-Ugruma is an Orsimer warrior who resides in Tel Aruhn located within Morrowind.
Molla is a Nord in who is found just north Bleakrock Village. After being turned back into her original form, she seeks help in finding her friends who were also turned into skeevers.
Monkeys are non-hostile creatures that appear throughout several regions in . They often drop bananas and white meat upon death.

Moglurkgul is an Orsimer residing in Port Hunding, Stros M'Kai. She is a member of the Bloody Fists serving under the Headman Bhosek. Moglurkgul was put in charge of tracking down and punishing Jakarn as well as retrieving the stolen gem.

Monya is a Redguard ghost found in the Temple of Mourning Springs after the quest "Tears of the Two Moons" has been completed and the ghosts have returned to the temple. She can be found playing the flute, whilst standing in the fountain of the temple.

Molg Music-Maker is an Orsimer Musician with a stand next to Bazgara's Horses in Daggerfall, Glenumbra. He says he is not a very good musician but a good craftsman making beautiful instruments. When asked if any of the instruments are for sale he bursts out and exclaims, "Are you mad? These instruments take years to make, each one lovingly crafted and selling them would be like selling your own children."
Monar is a Redguard on the island Betnikh, Glenumbra. He has a carpentry stall in the Stonetooth Market where he sells his items.
Modradil is a Bosmer warrior residing in Woodhearth in the region of Greenshade.
Mizahabi is a Khajiit found at the temple in Elden Root. She is looking for her missing dog, Eat Eat, and husband, Ninglenel.
Molamiel is a Bosmer residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood.
Mizarbuk is a Khajiit member of the Fighters Guild. He is found at their branch in Elden Root
Molly Farielle is a Breton residing in Koeglin Village, Stormhaven. She is the innkeeper at the Sleepy Sailor Inn.
Mivanu Andrelo is a Dunmer savant and member of House Redoran residing in her house inside the Redoran Council Hall, in Ald'ruhn.
Mol gro-Shat is an Orc warrior located in the Gandrung Caverns, in the Hirstaang Forest on the island of Solstheim. He guards the cave where his fellow smugglers are hiding out.
Eringor is a Bosmer member of the Brackenleaf's Briars residing in the Grahtwood town of Brackenleaf.
Mondran Redoran is a Dunmer of House Redoran residing in Ebonheart.
Molanor is an Altmer residing in the town of Silsailen, Auridon.
Mizareh is a Redguard merchant residing in the Marbruk Outlaws Refuge.
Mjornys Bitterblade is a Nord residing in the city of Windhelm.
Mjorn Mead-Drinker is a Nord residing in the city of Windhelm.

Molag Kena is a powerful Xivkyn who has been masquerading as the Empress regent, Clivia Tharn. She can be found at the White-Gold Tower Pinnacle at the end of the dungeon, in which she reveals herself and fights the Vestige. She serves as the sixth and final boss of the dungeon.
Molana Lake-Heart is a Nord soldier residing in the city of Riften. She can be found at the local marketplace.
Mongoth is a Bosmer chef residing in the town of Cormount. He owns and runs the Mongoth's Mouthwatering Meat inn there, where he sells various food items.
Moon-Draughts is a Khajiit brewer. She sells her wares at her stall at the Wayshrine Court in Dune.
Moleras is a Bosmer in residing at the Thizzrini Arena in Reaper's March, Valenwood.
Monennor is a Bosmer stablemaster residing in Velyn Harbor, Malabal Tor.
Mongor is a Bosmer found in the city of Orsinium. It is impossible to interact with him.
Moon-Seeker is a Khajiit moon priest. He is one of the few who survived the Stonefire Cult attack on the Do'Krin Monastery.
Mizrayda is a Redguard slave residing in the city of Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Mizibuk is a Khajiit residing in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane. He has no unique dialogue.
Mizdabih is a Redguard fence found in the Anvil Outlaws Refuge in Anvil, The Gold Coast.
Mohimeem is an Argonian residing in the Silent Mire, Deshaan.
Moon-Bishop Hunal is a Khajiit and the head of the moon priests in Dune.
Molacar is an Altmer member of the Supernal Dreamers. He can be found at Vaermina's Shrine located in Cyrodiil.
Mollyon is an Altmer commoner residing in the port city of Mistral, in Khenarthi's Roost. He is listening to Tahara with Arnurdurwe. He has no unique dialogue.
Monastic Falen is an Altmer residing in Greenwater Cove after the Maormer are driven away.
Monastic Firinore is an Altmer priestess guarding and maintaining the shrines located across the Ayleid ruins of Torinaan.
Monastic Nenaron is an Altmer priest that has been entrusted with keeping watch over sacred relics found at the shrines of Torinaan.
Monastic Tanaame is an Altmer priestess seeking help about the troubles at Torinaan.
Miun-Eidu is an Argonian member of the Ebonheart Pact stationed at Fort Virak.
Miuni is an Argonian found in the Dominion camp located just outside Cormount.
Modorin is a Bosmer laborer found outside the Temple Canton in Vivec City. He has no unique dialogue.
Mizou Jutras is a Breton refugee from Crestshade. She is found in Camp Tamrith.
Mollier Cine is a Breton member of the Fighters Guild. He is found at the Earth Forge.
Monis Drimas is a Dunmer leatherworker and a member of the Ebonheart Pact. He sells his wares at the smithy of the Southern Morrowind Gate.
Molvirian Lactucinus is an Imperial Commoner residing in Abah's Landing.
Montanus Sulla is a traveling Imperial merchant in . He is found on the road between Hallin's Stand and Yanurah's Respite in Bangkorai.
Mohkhu is a Khajiit laborer residing in Vivec City on Vvardenfell. He can be found hammering a door outside the Canton of St. Olms the Just. He has no unique dialogue.

Mock Turtle is a creature found in hidden in a secret area, just before the exit of Level 1: The Weir Gate. He is a reference to a character of the same name from Alice's Adventures in Wonderland by Lewis C. Carroll.
Montclair Knight is a generic Knight residing in . They are a member of House Montclair.
Mivanu Romoren is a Dunmer provisioner residing in Gnisis on Vvardenfell. She is wife to Goron Romoren. She has no unique dialogue.
Mog gro-Yggrub is an Orsimer residing in Jathsogur, Malabal Tor. He is found fishing at the docks west of the bridge.
Monastic Nuleros is an Altmer trying to take a nap on a bench in the Monastery of Serene Harmony in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset.
Monastery Sentry is an Altmer residing outside the Monastery of Serene Harmony in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset.

Mogrus the Dim is a guardian of the Labyrinthian's "secret of life," alongside his brother Kanen the Wise. Mogrus resides inside his own special domain within Skyrim's Labyrinthian, the Domain of Mogrus. Mogrus plays a major role in the main quest of .
Mizzik Thunderboots is a Khajiit detective residing in Riverhold, Northern Elsweyr.
Mizbina is a Khajiit residing in the Baandari Trading Post in Malabal Tor. She is a "moon-singer" who can be found telling the tale of Khunzar-ri and the Demon: Part Two.
Mojha is a Khajiit found at the Sunspire temple in Northern Elsweyr. He is one of the few there who sees through Nahviintaas's lie and assists the Vestige with freeing the Temple from his grasp.
Moon-Bishop Azin-jo is a Khajiit found at the Sunspire temple in Northern Elsweyr.
Mizarr is a Khajiit innkeeper who operates The Sugar Bowl in the city of Rimmen, Northern Elsweyr.
Mohsaz is a Khajiit commoner listening to a performance by Duzhargo on the upper floor of The Sugar Bowl in the city of Rimmen, Northern Elsweyr. He has no unique dialogue.
Moon-Kissed Jelly is a passive creature that appears in . They can be found in the Moonlit Cove, especially in the aquatic areas. They appear to be variants of Swamp Jellies.
Monamjo is a Khajiit gambler residing at in The Stitches in Northern Elsweyr. He has no unique dialogue.
Moon-Bishop Sizenza is a Dagi Khajiit in and the Moon-Bishop of the Two Moons at Tenmar Temple.
Moon-Priest Rilasu is a Khajiit in and a Moon-Priest at the Two Moons at Tenmar Temple.
Moon-Priest Zargha is a Dagi Khajiit in and a Moon-Priest of Two Moons at Tenmar Temple.
Moon-Singer Feziya-ko is a Khajiit Moon-Singer found at Southern Elsweyr world event locations in .

Keshjo is a Khajiit moon-priest found as part of a random encounter in Northern Elsweyr in . He offered food to Keshjo, Sulema and Zadeva in exchange for hearing him out, which turned out to be an attempt to convert them to his religion.
Monk Methas Irethi is a Dunmer residing in Holamayan Monastery in Vvardenfell.
Mobar is the Breton leader of the royal guard of Castle Daggerfall, in the court of King Gothryd.
Morihatha Septim was the nineteenth ruler of the Third Empire of Tamriel.

Morgiah is a Dark Elf Princess of Wayrest, in . As a result of the game's events, she likely became Queen of Firsthold. Her parents were Tiber Septim's General Symmachus and Mournhold's Queen Barenziah.

Movis Darys is a Dunmer member of the Dark Brotherhood who operated out of the town of Ald'ruhn, where he posed as a Mages Guild student. He later abandons the Brotherhood in favor of the Morag Tong, which Darys feels is more honorable.
Moris is a deceased Imperial male Smuggler whose body is found in Nerano Ancestral Tomb, near the Note from Bakarak. He is supposedly the brother of Bakarak.
Movisa Andas is a Dunmer Battlemage located in the Suran Tradehouse, in Suran.
Mor gra-Gamorn is an Orc priestess at the Shrine of Nocturnal. She is a devoted worshipper of Nocturnal. She chooses who is worthy to speak with her.

Msirae Faythung is a Nord warrior, and was Mehrunes Dagon's champion. He failed Dagon somehow, and Dagon carved his heart out and froze him like a statue for eternity, or at least until the Hero comes for Mehrunes' Razor.
Moria Uulentanus is an Imperial smuggler who resides in the cave of Nammu, in the Grazelands.
Moth gro-Bagol is an Orsimer who lives in Markarth. He is found in Understone Keep, upstairs and to the right, he serves as Blacksmith to the Jarl. He is also a potential candidate for marriage.
Mralki is a Nord and the owner of the Frostfruit Inn in Rorikstead.
Morven is a Breton member of the Forsworn and citizen of Markarth.
Mortyn was the King of Daggerfall in 3E 80. Nothing much is known about him. Gothlyr was his father.

Moraelyn, also known as The Witch-King, was a Chimer king of Ebonheart in the First Era. He approached the king of Wayrest seeking a trade deal that would allow him to mine for ebony in the Wrothgarian Mountains. Eventually, he left with the queen of Wayrest, Aliera. Moraelyn was the father of Edward. So far, he has appeared in fifteen books in the series King Edward.

Mother Pascost is a character that once resided in Falinesti. Decumus Scotti seeks her out when traveling there in the A Dance in Fire series. She reveals to Scotti that her middle son lives in Athay and manages a dairy there. She is also responsible for the introduction of the Kollopi dish to Simocles Quo.
Mororurg is an Altmer alchemist and vampire who resides in the vampire hideout of Ashmelech. He is a member of the Aundea vampire clan and sells alchemy supplies to fellow members.
Moric Sidrey is a Breton Vigilant of Stendarr in who resides at Ruunvald.

The Morag Tong Assassin is a Dunmer who appears in the jail of Sundercliff Watch. If released he will attempt to complete his mission to kill Commander Telani Adrethi. If killed, the Hero will find the Soiled Writ of Assassination on his body and they can loot the Morag Tong Assassin Armor.
Morwen is a Nord member of the Skaal tribe on Solstheim. Until the quest "The Fate of the Skaal" has been completed, she is one of the villagers building a temple around the Wind Stone.
Mornsu Omalor is a Dunmer archer and smuggler residing in the cave of Nammu in the Grazelands. Despite being armed with a large assortment of bows, she only has a single arrow.

Moroni Uvelas is a Dunmer trader who works in the St. Olms Brewers and Fishmongers Hall in the Vivec, St. Olms Canton. She is married to Danar Uvelas, a Skooma-addict who takes all her hard-earned money for his addiction.
Mother Murk is a Hagraven found at Hag Fen, Glenumbra. She is leading a coven of hags, and the Vestige must rescue kidnapped refugees and defeat her.
Morna is an Altmer weaponsmith residing in Woodhearth in the region of Greenshade.
Mrilen Aram is a Dunmer drunkard residing in Alcaire Castle, Stormhaven. He is found outside the Old Goat Inn, intoxicated and rambling.
Morgaz is an Orsimer, residing in Alcaire Castle, Stormhaven. He can be found sitting against a large rock in the middle of local marketplace.
Morg is an Orsimer residing in Wayrest in Stormhaven. He is a guild trader and has a stand at the Guild Traders market.
Morvani is a Dunmer and the daughter of Spellwright Girvas, the mayor of Senie. She has been missing since the eruption of Ash Mountain.
Mouse is a Khajiit slave working at the Dres House in Mournhold.
Mortine Langey is a Breton brewer who can be found at the Anchor's Point Inn in the city of Evermore.
Mrylav Aralor is a Dunmer bard in the Saint Delyn Waistworks within the Canton of St. Delyn the Wise in Vivec City, where he can be found singing while playing the lute.

Mordrog gro-Burgal, also known as the Suspicious Monkey, is an Orsimer citizen of Sentinel who can be found in the Frozen Palms Tavern upon completion of the quest "Monkey Magic." He was turned into a monkey after drinking a potion he bought from Unishi.
Motistaari is an Altmer member of the Aldmeri Dominion. She is found in S'ren-ja.
Mozgosh is an Orsimer residing in Hissmir, Shadowfen. She is the daughter of Gordag.
Mort the Merry is an Orsimer residing at the Dusklight Inn in the town of Hoarfrost Downs.
Morotub is an Orsimer of the Barkbite Clan residing in the city of Reman's Bluff, Grahtwood.

Moricar, also known as Moricar the Middling, was the Emperor of Cyrodiil during the Interregnum, following his father's death in 2E 542. He was part of the Longhouse Emperors bloodline, was the son of Emperor Durcorach, and father of Prince Leovic. He had noticeably large pectoral muscles.
Morthelos is a Bosmer fisher and celebrant in who resides in the city of Skywatch.
Morgane is a Breton leading the Worm Cult cell found in the crypts beneath Nimalten.
Morven Retiene is a Breton fence residing in the outlaws refuge in the city of Stormhold.
Motuu is an Argonian residing in the city of Stormhold. He is a weaponsmith, and the owner of Motuu's Finer Edge.
Mormelcarion is a Maormer mage found in the Manor District of Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane. He can be found walking watching Ashahdr's performance near Velmont Mansion.
Mozhenie is a Redguard found in the Diamond Thimble in the Bazaar District of Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane. She is impossible to interact with.
Mornamph is an Orsimer found in Enrick's Public House in Anvil, Gold Coast. She cannot be interacted with.
Morg gro-Graaum is an Orsimer member of the Horsemen found in Silverhoof Vale.
Moves-Like-Water is an Argonian found at the Hackdirt Refugee Camp in Cyrodiil.
Moves-Many-Rocks is an Argonian kept as a slave by the owners of Davenas Farm.
